description: This file implements an Azure OpenAI image generation service class that interacts with Azure's REST API to generate images from text prompts asynchronously, handling HTTP requests, polling for completion, and processing the resulting images.

classes.name: AzureImageGenServiceREST
classes.description: A class providing asynchronous image generation via Azure's REST API, extending the ImageGenService base class.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AzureImageGenServiceREST with configuration parameters such as image size, API key, endpoint, model, and aiohttp session.

methods.name: run_image_gen
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an image from a text prompt, polling for completion, and yields a frame with the image or an error frame.
